claim_results.claim: In that silence, you learn patience, because there is no alternative to patience.
Not because the structure forces him — the structure is gone.
Because he *decides*, and then he stops deciding.

A story about what happens when the structures that held us together — geography, scarcity, community, church, silence, patience, the sheer cost of seeing a girl who lives six miles away — are removed one by one, and nothing replaces them. **Can we measure it?** Not with nostalgia.
Not because people are evil, but because the shared meaning that makes correction *possible* has dissolved.
Crime rates measure breakdown after it manifests.
Not because the justices were evil.
Because the culture had already moved, and the law followed.

K1 RECOVERY WITHOUT β If any society recovers from χ < 0.35 to χ > 0.50 *without* activation of external constraint or transcendent authority, the model fails.
K2 COLLAPSE WITH β If a society with sustained high constraint pressure (P > 0.7) and active external input still collapses to χ < 0.35, the model fails.
If any civilization demonstrates economic collapse *preceding* semantic collapse, the invariant cascade is wrong.
